xmldoc.short_description: Names of the superclasses of a class.

param_input_item.param_description: a class name as a string or character vector.

param_output_item.param_description: an N-by-1 cell array of char with the names of all visible superclasses, nearest ancestor first.

description.p: superclasses returns the names of all visible superclasses of a class, whether specified by name or by an object of that class. Ancestors are returned nearest first, and each name appears once.

example_item.example_item_description: Names of the superclasses of a class.
